senses.gloss: weaver of metallic thread, artistic weaver, differ. fr. גַּרְדִּי.—Pl. טַרְסִיִּים.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17b">Ab. Zar. 17ᵇ</cite> Ar. a. Ms. Pes. (ed. <cite ref="V00996"><he>תרס׳</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40).

<cite ref="Sukkah 51b:7">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>וט׳ בפ״ע וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) artistic weavers apart and common weavers apart; <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:6">Tosef. ib. IV, 6</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 47a:6">Sabb. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>מטה של ט׳</he> the weavers’ horizontal loom or frame for embroidery (differ. in Rashi).
<cite ref="Chullin 57b:8">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>מטלית של ט׳</he> the bronzers’ apron.
